    rVotedRawVolt_mV := (rPyroRaw_ChA_mV + rPyroRaw_ChC_mV) * 0.5;
    bVolt_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    rVotedRawVolt_mV := rPyroChannel_mV;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.0 SAPPHIRE-GaN INTERFACE THERMODYNAMICS & THERMAL SHOCK DECOMPOSITION WAVE PROFILING    *)
(* Evaluates transient non-equilibrium heat diffusion, Arrhenius dissociation, gas pressure  *)
(* and thermoelastic acoustic compressive/tensile stress generation at the hetero-boundary.  *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* 3.1 Net Optical Energy Coupled Across Transparent Sapphire Backside *)
(* Incident beam passes through sapphire with 1.2% bulk absorption and 2.65% interface reflection *)
rAbsorbedOpticalFluence_mJcm2 := rVotedFluence_mJcm2 * (1.0 - c_rFresnelInterfaceReflect) * 0.988;

(* 3.2 1D Transient Thermal Diffusion Length: l_th = 2 * sqrt(D * tau_p) *)
(* For GaN with D = 4.314E-5 m2/s and tau_p = 30 ns, l_th ~ 72.0 nm *)
rHeatDiffusionLength_nm := 2.0 * SQRT(c_rGaNThermalDiffusivity_m2s * (c_rLaserPulseDuration_ns * 1.0E-9)) * 1.0E9;
IF rHeatDiffusionLength_nm < 10.0 THEN
    rHeatDiffusionLength_nm := 10.0;
END_IF;

(* 3.3 Peak Transient Interfacial Temperature Rise via Non-Equilibrium Energy Deposition *)
(* Volumetric enthalpy density: Delta_H = Phi_abs / (delta_opt + l_th) *)
rTmpA := (c_rOpticalSkinDepth_nm + rHeatDiffusionLength_nm) * 1.0E-7; (* Convert nm to cm *)
IF rTmpA > 0.0 THEN
    rVolumetricHeatSource_Jcm3 := (rAbsorbedOpticalFluence_mJcm2 * 1.0E-3) / rTmpA;
ELSE
    rVolumetricHeatSource_Jcm3 := 1000.0;
END_IF;

(* Delta_T = Delta_H / (rho * Cp) where rho = 6.15 g/cm3, Cp = 0.490 J/(g*K) -> rho*Cp = 3.0135 J/(cm3*K) *)
rTmpB := rVolumetricHeatSource_Jcm3 / 3.0135;
rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC := rChuckPlateTemp_degC + rTmpB;
rCalculatedPeakTemp_degC := rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC;

(* Interfacial Thermal Gradient Spike Alert *)
IF rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC > 1350.0 THEN
    bThermalShockAlert := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Interface Over-Temperature Trip Hazard *)
ELSIF rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC > 1200.0 THEN
    bThermalShockAlert := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0800; (* High Thermal Gradient Warning *)
ELSE
    bThermalShockAlert := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 3.4 GaN Interfacial Thermal Decomposition Kinetics (Arrhenius Dissociation) *)
(* 2 GaN (solid) -> 2 Ga (liquid) + N2 (gas); Activation Energy Ea ~ 3.10 eV = 4.966E-19 J *)
IF rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC >= 850.0 THEN
    (* Effective decomposition reaction velocity v_decomp [m/s] *)
    rTmpC := (rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC - 850.0) / 450.0;
    IF rTmpC > 1.5 THEN rTmpC := 1.5; END_IF;
    rArrheniusReactionRate := 0.850 * (rTmpC * rTmpC); (* Empirical decomposition velocity [m/s] *)
    rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm := rArrheniusReactionRate * (c_rLaserPulseDuration_ns * 1.0E-9) * 1.0E9 + 18.0;
ELSE
    rArrheniusReactionRate := 0.0;
    rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm := 0.0;
END_IF;
rDecompositionDepth_nm := rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm;

(* 3.5 Interfacial Nitrogen (N2) Gas Pressure Accumulation *)
(* Confined volume model: moles of N2 per unit area = 0.5 * (rho_GaN * d_decomp / M_GaN) *)
IF rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm > 0.1 THEN
    rEvolvedN2GasMoles_molcm2 := 0.5 * (6.150 * (rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm * 1.0E-7) / 83.73);
    (* Assume confined micro-void thickness h_void ~ 12.0 nm at interface *)
    (* P_N2 = n * R * T / V [bar] *)
    rCalculatedN2Pressure_bar := (rEvolvedN2GasMoles_molcm2 * c_rUniversalGasConst_JmolK *
                                 (rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC + 273.15)) / (12.0E-7 * 1.0E5);
ELSE
    rCalculatedN2Pressure_bar := 0.0;
END_IF;
rDecompositionPressure_bar := rCalculatedN2Pressure_bar;

(* 3.6 Thermoelastic Acoustic Shock Wave Stress Amplitude *)
(* Sigma_acoustic = Gamma * alpha * Phi_absorbed / 2 [MPa] *)
rPeakAcousticShockStress_MPa := (c_rGruneisenParamGaN * (c_rGaNAbsorptionCoeff_cm) *
                                 (rAbsorbedOpticalFluence_mJcm2 * 1.0E-3 * 1.0E-4) * 0.5) / 1.0E6;
rAcousticStressPeak_MPa := rPeakAcousticShockStress_MPa;

(* 3.7 Spallation / Micro-LED Mesa Delamination Verification *)
(* Separation occurs when acoustic recoil and gas expansion overcome GaN adhesion (~85.0 MPa) *)
IF (rCalculatedN2Pressure_bar >= 45.0) AND (rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm >= 12.0) THEN
    bDecompositionVerified := TRUE;
    rGaNSpallationRatio := 1.0;
ELSE
    bDecompositionVerified := FALSE;
    rGaNSpallationRatio := rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm / 12.0;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.0 OPTICAL HOMOGENIZER FLAT-TOP SPATIAL PROFILING & RAYLEIGH RANGE COMPUTATION           *)
(* Evaluates multi-zone plateau uniformity, edge steepness, and short-axis Rayleigh focus.   *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* 4.1 Flat-Top Plateau Uniformity Calculation across Left, Center, Right Zones *)
rPlateMax := rBeamPlateau_Left_mJcm2;
IF rBeamPlateau_Center_mJcm2 > rPlateMax THEN rPlateMax := rBeamPlateau_Center_mJcm2; END_IF;
IF rBeamPlateau_Right_mJcm2 > rPlateMax THEN rPlateMax := rBeamPlateau_Right_mJcm2; END_IF;
rPlateauMaxFluence_mJcm2 := rPlateMax;

rPlateMin := rBeamPlateau_Left_mJcm2;
IF rBeamPlateau_Center_mJcm2 < rPlateMin THEN rPlateMin := rBeamPlateau_Center_mJcm2; END_IF;
IF rBeamPlateau_Right_mJcm2 < rPlateMin THEN rPlateMin := rBeamPlateau_Right_mJcm2; END_IF;
rPlateauMinFluence_mJcm2 := rPlateMin;

rPlateauFluenceSpread_mJcm2 := rPlateauMaxFluence_mJcm2 - rPlateauMinFluence_mJcm2;

IF (rPlateauMaxFluence_mJcm2 + rPlateauMinFluence_mJcm2) > 1.0 THEN
    rBeamHomogeneityUniformity := (1.0 - (rPlateauFluenceSpread_mJcm2 /
                                         (rPlateauMaxFluence_mJcm2 + rPlateauMinFluence_mJcm2))) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rBeamHomogeneityUniformity := 0.0;
END_IF;
rBeamFlatTopUniformity_pct := rBeamHomogeneityUniformity;

(* 4.2 Rayleigh Range & Short-Axis Beam Expansion under Defocus *)
(* z_R = pi * w0^2 / (lambda * M^2) ~ 18.5 um *)
rActualRayleighRange_um := c_rNominalRayleighRange_um;
rRayleighDepthOfFocus_um := rActualRayleighRange_um;

(* Beam waist broadening: w(z) = w0 * sqrt(1 + (z / z_R)^2) *)
rLocalFocusDeviation_um := rVotedFocus_um;
rTmpD := rLocalFocusDeviation_um / rActualRayleighRange_um;
rBeamWaistExpansionFactor := SQRT(1.0 + (rTmpD * rTmpD));

(* Defocus Warning Interlock *)
IF ABS(rLocalFocusDeviation_um) > 2.50 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Severe Focal Excursion Trip Hazard *)
ELSIF ABS(rLocalFocusDeviation_um) > 1.20 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_1000; (* Defocus Warning *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.0 PIEZOELECTRIC SUB-MICRON STAGE ANTI-RESONANCE BIQUAD DIGITAL NOTCH FILTER             *)
(* Filters out 2.40 kHz mechanical structural eigenmode to prevent stage oscillation.        *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* Numerical derivative of piezo stage feedback to track vertical velocity [um/s] *)
rPiezoStageVelocity_ums := (rPiezoPositionFeedback_um - rPrevPiezoFeedback_um) / c_rScanTimeSeconds;
rPrevPiezoFeedback_um := rPiezoPositionFeedback_um;

(* Biquad Notch Difference Equation: y[k] = b0*x[k] + b1*x[k-1] + b2*x[k-2] - a1*y[k-1] - a2*y[k-2] *)
rTmpE := (rNotch_b0 * rLocalFocusDeviation_um) + (rNotch_b1 * rNotch_x1) + (rNotch_b2 * rNotch_x2) -
         (rNotch_a1 * rNotch_y1) - (rNotch_a2 * rNotch_y2);

(* Update Biquad Internal Delay Line *)
rNotch_x2 := rNotch_x1;
rNotch_x1 := rLocalFocusDeviation_um;
rNotch_y2 := rNotch_y1;
rNotch_y1 := rTmpE;
rFilteredPiezoDemand_um := rTmpE;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.0 COMPLETE 6-STATE DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE MODEL & MPC QUADRATIC OPTIMIZATION         *)
(* Discretized plant: x[k+1] = Ad*x[k] + Bd*u[k]; y[k] = Cd*x[k] + Dd*u[k]                  *)
(* Solves real-time quadratic cost gradient: J = x'*Q*x + u'*R*u via Cramer's Rule.          *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* 6.1 Assemble Current State Deviation Vector x *)
x1_FluenceDev  := rVotedFluence_mJcm2 - rTargetFluence_mJcm2;
x2_FocusDev    := rVotedFocus_um - rTargetFocus_um;
x3_TempDev     := rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC - rTargetInterfaceTemp_degC;
x4_DecompDev   := rActiveDecompositionDepth_nm - rTargetDecompDepth_nm;
x5_HomogDev    := rBeamHomogeneityUniformity - rTargetUniformity_pct;
x6_FocusVelDev := rPiezoStageVelocity_ums;

(* 6.2 1-Step Ahead State Prediction Vector: x_next = Ad * x + Bd * u *)
x1_Next := (Ad_11 * x1_FluenceDev) + (Ad_12 * x2_FocusDev) + (Ad_13 * x3_TempDev) +
           (Ad_14 * x4_DecompDev) + (Ad_15 * x5_HomogDev) + (Ad_16 * x6_FocusVelDev) +
           (Bd_11 * rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd) + (Bd_12 * rDeltaPiezo_Cmd);

x2_Next := (Ad_21 * x1_FluenceDev) + (Ad_22 * x2_FocusDev) + (Ad_23 * x3_TempDev) +
           (Ad_24 * x4_DecompDev) + (Ad_25 * x5_HomogDev) + (Ad_26 * x6_FocusVelDev) +
           (Bd_21 * rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd) + (Bd_22 * rDeltaPiezo_Cmd);

x3_Next := (Ad_31 * x1_FluenceDev) + (Ad_32 * x2_FocusDev) + (Ad_33 * x3_TempDev) +
           (Ad_34 * x4_DecompDev) + (Ad_35 * x5_HomogDev) + (Ad_36 * x6_FocusVelDev) +
           (Bd_31 * rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd) + (Bd_32 * rDeltaPiezo_Cmd);

x4_Next := (Ad_41 * x1_FluenceDev) + (Ad_42 * x2_FocusDev) + (Ad_43 * x3_TempDev) +
           (Ad_44 * x4_DecompDev) + (Ad_45 * x5_HomogDev) + (Ad_46 * x6_FocusVelDev) +
           (Bd_41 * rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd) + (Bd_42 * rDeltaPiezo_Cmd);

x5_Next := (Ad_51 * x1_FluenceDev) + (Ad_52 * x2_FocusDev) + (Ad_53 * x3_TempDev) +
           (Ad_54 * x4_DecompDev) + (Ad_55 * x5_HomogDev) + (Ad_56 * x6_FocusVelDev) +
           (Bd_51 * rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd) + (Bd_52 * rDeltaPiezo_Cmd);

x6_Next := (Ad_61 * x1_FluenceDev) + (Ad_62 * x2_FocusDev) + (Ad_63 * x3_TempDev) +
           (Ad_64 * x4_DecompDev) + (Ad_65 * x5_HomogDev) + (Ad_66 * x6_FocusVelDev) +
           (Bd_61 * rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd) + (Bd_62 * rDeltaPiezo_Cmd);

(* 6.3 Predicted Observable Process Outputs *)
rMPCPredictedFluence  := (Cd_11 * x1_Next) + (Cd_12 * x2_Next) + (Cd_13 * x3_Next) +
                         (Cd_14 * x4_Next) + (Cd_15 * x5_Next) + (Cd_16 * x6_Next) + rTargetFluence_mJcm2;
rMPCPredictedFocusErr := (Cd_21 * x1_Next) + (Cd_22 * x2_Next) + (Cd_23 * x3_Next) +
                         (Cd_24 * x4_Next) + (Cd_25 * x5_Next) + (Cd_26 * x6_Next) + rTargetFocus_um;

(* 6.4 Analytical Gradient Vector: g = B' * Q * x *)
rGrad1 := (Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_Fluence * x1_FluenceDev) +
          (Bd_21 * rMPC_Weight_Focus * x2_FocusDev) +
          (Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_Temp * x3_TempDev) +
          (Bd_41 * rMPC_Weight_Decomp * x4_DecompDev) +
          (Bd_51 * rMPC_Weight_Homog * x5_HomogDev) +
          (Bd_61 * rMPC_Weight_FocusVel * x6_FocusVelDev);

rGrad2 := (Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_Fluence * x1_FluenceDev) +
          (Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_Focus * x2_FocusDev) +
          (Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_Temp * x3_TempDev) +
          (Bd_42 * rMPC_Weight_Decomp * x4_DecompDev) +
          (Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_Homog * x5_HomogDev) +
          (Bd_62 * rMPC_Weight_FocusVel * x6_FocusVelDev);

(* 6.5 Projected 2x2 Hessian Matrix: H = B' * Q * B + R *)
rHess11 := (Bd_11 * Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_Fluence) +
           (Bd_21 * Bd_21 * rMPC_Weight_Focus) +
           (Bd_31 * Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_Temp) +
           (Bd_41 * Bd_41 * rMPC_Weight_Decomp) +
           (Bd_51 * Bd_51 * rMPC_Weight_Homog) +
           (Bd_61 * Bd_61 * rMPC_Weight_FocusVel) + rMPC_Weight_dAttenuator;

rHess22 := (Bd_12 * Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_Fluence) +
           (Bd_22 * Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_Focus) +
           (Bd_32 * Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_Temp) +
           (Bd_42 * Bd_42 * rMPC_Weight_Decomp) +
           (Bd_52 * Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_Homog) +
           (Bd_62 * Bd_62 * rMPC_Weight_FocusVel) + rMPC_Weight_dPiezo;

rHess12 := (Bd_11 * Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_Fluence) +
           (Bd_21 * Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_Focus) +
           (Bd_31 * Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_Temp) +
           (Bd_41 * Bd_42 * rMPC_Weight_Decomp) +
           (Bd_51 * Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_Homog) +
           (Bd_61 * Bd_62 * rMPC_Weight_FocusVel);

(* 6.6 Invert 2x2 Projected System via Cramer's Rule: Delta_u* = - H^-1 * g *)
rDetHess := (rHess11 * rHess22) - (rHess12 * rHess12);

IF rDetHess > 1.0E-5 THEN
    rUnconstrained_u1 := - ((rHess22 * rGrad1) - (rHess12 * rGrad2)) / rDetHess;
    rUnconstrained_u2 := - ((rHess11 * rGrad2) - (rHess12 * rGrad1)) / rDetHess;
    bDegradedControlMode := FALSE;
ELSE
    (* Ill-conditioned Hessian Fallback to Decoupled Gradient Descent *)
    rUnconstrained_u1 := - 0.045 * rGrad1;
    rUnconstrained_u2 := - 0.020 * rGrad2;
    bDegradedControlMode := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_2000; (* MPC Ill-Conditioned Hessian Warning *)
END_IF;

(* 6.7 Enforce Hard Slew-Rate Limits and Actuator Authority Bounds *)
(* Attenuator slew limit: +/- 0.85 deg per ms *)
IF rUnconstrained_u1 > 0.85 THEN
    rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd := 0.85;
ELSIF rUnconstrained_u1 < -0.85 THEN
    rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd := -0.85;
ELSE
    rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd := rUnconstrained_u1;
END_IF;

(* Piezo stage slew limit: +/- 0.15 um per ms *)
IF rUnconstrained_u2 > 0.15 THEN
    rDeltaPiezo_Cmd := 0.15;
ELSIF rUnconstrained_u2 < -0.15 THEN
    rDeltaPiezo_Cmd := -0.15;
ELSE
    rDeltaPiezo_Cmd := rUnconstrained_u2;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.0 FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) - MULTI-STAGE STEP-AND-SCAN EXPOSURE CORE                  *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: UNINITIALIZED / POWER-ON SELF TEST (POST) *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaserFirePermissive := FALSE;
        bBeamShutterOpenCmd := FALSE;
        rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um := -25.0; (* Objective safe parked *)
        rAttenuatorAngle_Cmd_deg := 45.0; (* Full extinction *)
        rLaserRepRate_Cmd_Hz := 0.0;
        rN2PurgeFlow_Cmd_sccm := 500.0;
        rVacuumValvePosition_pct := 0.0;
        rStateTimerAccum := rStateTimerAccum + c_rScanTimeSeconds;

        IF (rStateTimerAccum >= 1.50) AND (dwAlarmWord_1 = 16#0000_0000) THEN
            rStateTimerAccum := 0.0;
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Purge and Chuck Clamp *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: OPTICAL SHROUD PURGE & VACUUM CHUCK CLAMPING *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rN2PurgeFlow_Cmd_sccm := 1500.0;
        rVacuumValvePosition_pct := 100.0;
        rStateTimerAccum := rStateTimerAccum + c_rScanTimeSeconds;

        (* Check vacuum clamping (< 0.100 mbar) and N2 purge flow (> 1000 sccm) *)
        IF (rVotedVacuum_mbar <= 0.080) AND (rN2PurgeFlow_sccm >= 1000.0) AND (rStateTimerAccum >= 2.0) THEN
            rStateTimerAccum := 0.0;
            iState := 20; (* Transition to Homogenizer Auto-Collimation *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: HOMOGENIZER AUTO-COLLIMATION & ATTENUATOR HOMING *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        rAttenuatorAngle_Cmd_deg := 22.5; (* Nominal half-angle *)
        rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um := 0.0;      (* Nominal mid-stroke *)
        rStateTimerAccum := rStateTimerAccum + c_rScanTimeSeconds;

        IF (rStateTimerAccum >= 1.0) AND bEnableSystem AND NOT bSystemTrip THEN
            rStateTimerAccum := 0.0;
            iState := 30; (* Transition to Wafer Topography Pre-Scan *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: WAFER SURFACE TOPOGRAPHY MAPPING & PRE-FOCUS *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        rStateTimerAccum := rStateTimerAccum + c_rScanTimeSeconds;

        (* Engage chromatic confocal surface height detection *)
        IF (ABS(rVotedFocus_um) <= 15.0) AND (rStateTimerAccum >= 0.50) THEN
            rStateTimerAccum := 0.0;
            iState := 40; (* Proceed to Closed-Loop Flying Focus Engagement *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: CLOSED-LOOP FLYING FOCUS ENGAGEMENT & PIEZO DYNAMIC TRACKING *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := TRUE;

        (* Apply filtered notch command to piezo Z-axis *)
        rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um := rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um - (rFilteredPiezoDemand_um * 0.85);
        IF rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um > 35.0 THEN rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um := 35.0; END_IF;
        IF rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um < -35.0 THEN rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um := -35.0; END_IF;

        IF ABS(rVotedFocus_um) <= 0.40 THEN
            bFlyingFocusLocked := TRUE;
            rStateTimerAccum := rStateTimerAccum + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
            IF rStateTimerAccum >= 0.20 THEN
                rStateTimerAccum := 0.0;
                iState := 50; (* Proceed to High-Energy Exposure *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            bFlyingFocusLocked := FALSE;
            rStateTimerAccum := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: HIGH-ENERGY EXCIMER FLAT-TOP LASER LIFT-OFF EXPOSURE *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaserFirePermissive := TRUE;
        bBeamShutterOpenCmd := TRUE;
        rLaserRepRate_Cmd_Hz := rLaserRepRate_Hz;

        (* Real-Time Closed-Loop Dosage via Dielectric Attenuator Modulation *)
        rTmpF := rAttenuatorAngle_Cmd_deg + (rDeltaAttenuator_Cmd * c_rScanTimeSeconds * 50.0);
        IF rTmpF > 42.0 THEN
            rAttenuatorAngle_Cmd_deg := 42.0;
        ELSIF rTmpF < 5.0 THEN
            rAttenuatorAngle_Cmd_deg := 5.0;
        ELSE
            rAttenuatorAngle_Cmd_deg := rTmpF;
        END_IF;

        (* Active Piezo Dynamic Focus Tracking *)
        rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um := rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um + (rDeltaPiezo_Cmd * c_rScanTimeSeconds * 25.0);
        IF rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um > 40.0 THEN rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um := 40.0; END_IF;
        IF rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um < -40.0 THEN rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um := -40.0; END_IF;

        (* Verify Fluence within Closed-Loop Process Window (+/- 1.5%) *)
        IF ABS(rVotedFluence_mJcm2 - rTargetFluence_mJcm2) <= (rTargetFluence_mJcm2 * 0.015) THEN
            bDosageInTolerance := TRUE;
        ELSE
            bDosageInTolerance := FALSE;
        END_IF;

        (* Total Wafer Optical Dose Accumulator *)
        rCumulativeWaferDose_J := rCumulativeWaferDose_J +
            ((rVotedFluence_mJcm2 * 1.0E-3) * (rHomogenizerSlitLength_mm * 0.1 * rHomogenizerSlitWidth_mm * 0.1));

        (* Check Interfacial Conditions *)
        IF bThermalShockAlert THEN
            iState := 60; (* Divert to Thermal Shock Mitigation *)
        ELSIF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 80; (* Transition to Post-Exposure Purge *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: THERMAL SHOCK & DECOMPOSITION WAVE REGULATION GOVERNOR *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        (* Immediately increase attenuator angle to trim fluence by 8.5% *)
        rAttenuatorAngle_Cmd_deg := rAttenuatorAngle_Cmd_deg + (1.20 * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
        IF rAttenuatorAngle_Cmd_deg > 42.0 THEN rAttenuatorAngle_Cmd_deg := 42.0; END_IF;

        (* When interface temperature normalizes, return to nominal exposure *)
        IF (rGaNInterfacePeakTemp_degC <= 1120.0) AND NOT bThermalShockAlert THEN
            iState := 50; (* Resume Nominal Exposure *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: WAFER STEP-AND-SCAN FIELD-BY-FIELD RETICLE ADVANCE *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bLaserFirePermissive := FALSE;
        bBeamShutterOpenCmd := FALSE;
        rStateTimerAccum := rStateTimerAccum + c_rScanTimeSeconds;

        (* Retract piezo slightly during air-bearing XY traverse *)
        rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um := -5.0;

        IF rStateTimerAccum >= 0.080 THEN
            rStateTimerAccum := 0.0;
            iExposureFieldIdx := iExposureFieldIdx + 1;
            IF iExposureFieldIdx >= iTotalFieldsOnWafer THEN
                iState := 80; (* Wafer Complete *)
            ELSE
                iState := 40; (* Relock Flying Focus on Next Reticle *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE 80: POST-EXPOSURE DELAMINATION VERIFICATION & PURGE *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaserFirePermissive := FALSE;
        bBeamShutterOpenCmd := FALSE;
        rPiezoFocusZ_Cmd_um := -25.0;
        rAttenuatorAngle_Cmd_deg := 45.0;
        rLaserRepRate_Cmd_Hz := 0.0;
        rStateTimerAccum := rStateTimerAccum + c_rScanTimeSeconds;

        IF rStateTimerAccum >= 3.0 THEN
            rStateTimerAccum := 0.0;
            iExposureFieldIdx := 0;
            iState := 10; (* Return to Standby Ready *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE 90: EMERGENCY LASER BEAM DUMP & RAPID SUB-MICRON RETRACT *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
